evals.prompt: Send our monthly newsletter to all contacts.
evals.expected_output: Campaign lifecycle: check contacts, campaigns-create, review via get, send with {campaign_id}, confirm status.
expectations: Uses campaigns-create then campaigns-send (not transactional loop)

evals.prompt: I scheduled a campaign by mistake — stop it.
evals.expected_output: Uses campaigns-cancel and notes it only works before sending starts.

evals.prompt: Import this 50k purchased email list and blast it.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back: verify addresses first, expects bounce/complaint harm, recommends hygiene via contacts + verification.
